page_title: BOL 1-0 FIO | Bologna v Fiorentina 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Santiago Castro goes off the pitch and Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) comes on.
89' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is booked.
86' Fiorentina fail to score from a corner as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.
86' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
82' Yellow card. Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
82' Substitution. Lucas Beltran walks off the pitch and Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
82' Stefano Citterio prepares a substitution. Robin Gosens is replaced by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina).
81' It's time for a substitution. Stefan Posch (Bologna) comes on in place of Lorenzo De Silvestri.

81' A neat pass is well received by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
81' Benjamin Dominguez will be replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Bologna).

80' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lukasz Skorupski shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
79' Santiago Castro (Bologna) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
77' The ball is cleared after Dodo (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
77' Substitution. Emil Holm makes his way off the pitch and Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) comes on as his replacement.
71' Santiago Castro (Bologna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
70' Stefano Citterio has decided to substitute Andrea Colpani and he is replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) replaces Danilo Cataldi.
69' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

68' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the bottom left corner, but David de Gea pulls off a great save to deny him.
65' Michael Fabbri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna).
63' That's a well-taken pass by Emil Holm (Bologna). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
59' 1 - 0 Goal! Remo Freuler tees up Jens Odgaard (Bologna) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the left side of the goal. 1:0.
58' Stefano Citterio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) replacing Albert Gudmundsson.
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.

55' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. David de Gea pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

50' A cross to the edge of the box finds Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) who takes a nice first touch and tries to beat the keeper with quick shot towards the bottom left corner. David de Gea pulls off a good save and the score remains the same.
49' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul.

48' Santiago Castro (Bologna) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from just outside the box wasn't accurate enough and the ball bounced away off the left post!
46' Vincenzo Italiano makes a half-time substitution. Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) comes on in place of Dan Ndoye.
46' Referee Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Good chance! Dan Ndoye (Bologna) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
45+1' Michael Fabbri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) and blew his whistle.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) won himself just enough space to connect with the corner inside the box. His header flew towards the right post, but the goalkeeper dived superbly to stop the effort.
45' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Great touch by Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
42' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' Michael Fabbri blows for a foul after Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
39' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. It's a free kick to Fiorentina in a dangerous position.
37' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
33' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle as Emil Holm (Bologna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
31' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
29' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) unleashes a mid-range direct free kick, but sees his strike well saved by the goalkeeper.
22' Remo Freuler (Bologna) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
21' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Michael Fabbri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
19' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has a goal ruled out for offside!
17' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
16' Dodo (Fiorentina) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
15' It looks like Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) saw red with that tackle. Michael Fabbri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
15' Two players stand over the free kick. Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
13' What was Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
12' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
12' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Lukasz Skorupski.
10' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
9' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
7' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

3' Santiago Castro (Bologna) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Fiorentina will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Fabbri.
